categories.title: Categories
categories.intro: The subjects the single stories are sorted into. One flat list, no levels; its order is the order of the tabs on the board.
categories.name: Name
categories.deleteWarning: {{name}} will be deleted. Stories sorted into it move to "Other".
categories.createError: The category could not be created.
categories.saveError: The category could not be saved.
categories.deleteError: The category could not be deleted.
categories.loadError: Could not load the categories. Is the backend running?
categories.vocabularyHint: The AI picks from this list when it sorts a story. It hits a few terms with clear meanings more reliably than many that overlap.

feeds.title: Sources
feeds.intro: The sources the news are fetched from. Usually an RSS or Atom feed; where a site offers none, the site itself is read. A source carries no category — the AI assigns one per story.
feeds.name: Name
feeds.urlHint: The address of the RSS or Atom feed, starting with http:// or https://.
feeds.urlInvalid: That does not look like an address.
feeds.urlTaken: That address is already in the catalog.
feeds.deleteWarning: {{name}} will be deleted, and the news already fetched from it with it.
feeds.createError: The source could not be created.
feeds.saveError: The source could not be saved.
feeds.deleteError: The source could not be deleted.
feeds.loadError: Could not load the sources. Is the backend running?
feeds.typeFeedHint: The address of the feed that is read.
feeds.typePageHint: This page is read directly, because it offers no feed.
feeds.searchHint: The ordinary address is enough, say heise.de. The server looks for the feed address itself.
feeds.searchError: The address could not be checked.
feeds.noFeedFound: No feed was found behind this address.

picks.title: My picks
picks.intro: Tick the categories you want to see on the board.
picks.showingAll: Nothing ticked — you see every category.
picks.noCategories: No category yet. An administrator creates them.
picks.displayOnlyHint: The choice only orders what is shown. Everything entered as a source is fetched and rated either way.
picks.saveError: The picks could not be saved.
picks.loadError: Could not load the categories. Is the backend running?
picks.leaveWarning: The picks are not saved. Leaving loses them.

company.signatureHint: Put under every reply draft. The placeholders are filled in with the person's, their branch's and the company's data when a draft is written. Lines whose placeholders stay empty are left out.

aiSettings.title: AI access
aiSettings.intro: By default the AI runs on good news ai's own access. A tenant that stores its own Anthropic key is billed through its own account from then on.
aiSettings.statePlatform: This tenant uses good news ai's access.
aiSettings.stateOwn: This tenant uses its own key. Costs go through its Anthropic account.
aiSettings.apiKeyHint: Starts with sk-ant-. The key is stored encrypted and never shown again.
aiSettings.apiKeyInvalid: That does not look like an Anthropic key.
aiSettings.removed: Key removed. The tenant is back on good news ai's access.
aiSettings.loadError: Could not load the AI access. Is the backend running?
